sources.title: gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-heretic-NVFP4 - FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Model Optimizations This model was obtained by quantizing the weights and activations of coder3101/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-heretic to FP4 data type using the NVFP4 format, ready for inference with vLLM. This optimization reduces the number of bits per parameter from 16 to 4, reducing the disk size and GPU memory requirements by approximately 68%.
